seen.extent: One telegram form, Rio no. 1454, received Curitiba 7 Oct 1914: three cipher words (16, 8 and 5 letters) in a clear telegram, repeated once as a service check.
seen.cipher: Vigenère with the key restarted per word; all three cipher words carry a pencil gloss on the sheet: 'restabelecimento', 'harmonia' and 'Pedro' (the last one, over AFTGC, was missed in the lead record).

prior_art.decode: Searched the DECODE dumps for Brazil, Brasil and Setembrino: not on DECODE.
prior_art.tomokiyo: Nothing on cryptiana for Brazilian 1914 army ciphers (web search) and nothing in the repo ledgers.
prior_art.lasry: No Lasry paper or GL.htm entry covers it (known.py and web search).
prior_art.edition: No printed edition known; the reading is the contemporary pencil gloss on the telegram itself.
prior_art.literature: Web searches (Portuguese and English) on 1914 War Ministry cipher telegrams and the Contestado war found nothing on this telegram.

vetting.key_check: The glosses give the key LBQPOHVJ (Vigenère, standard alphabet, restarted per word) consistently for all three words; letter 15 of the first word is a transmission slip. Nothing in it is unread. The key does not read the Ceará telegrams of lead 1470, which use other keys.
vetting.duplicates: known.py on 'FSC cont 1914', 'Vespasiano', 'Setembrino': hits only on this lead and 1470; no catalogue entry, target or DECODE id.

lead_updates.folio_note: 1 f.; DocReader bib FSC_CONTEST pagfis 587. Clear telegram with cipher words CFIIOIZUPDYBSUDX - SBHBCUDJ - AFTGC, repeated as service check; pencil glosses 'restabelecimento', 'harmonia', 'Pedro' over all three.
lead_updates.status_append: Vetted 28 Oct 2026: all three cipher words glossed at the time (AFTGC = 'Pedro'); key LBQPOHVJ, Vigenère restarted per word; it does not read 1470 (different key). Verdict read; useful only as evidence of the system.
